name: External Links
description: Opens links to other sites in a new tab, adds a small arrow so readers know they are leaving, and sets noopener and optional nofollow for you. No JavaScript.

panels.title: External links
panels.description: How links to other websites behave on this site. Links to your own pages never change. Changes apply to a page the next time it is published.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Handle links to other sites
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every link exactly as it was.

fields.name: new-tab
fields.title: Open them in a new tab
fields.description: A link you already set to open in a certain way keeps that. Screen readers hear "opens in a new tab".

fields.name: icon
fields.title: Show a small arrow after the link

fields.name: nofollow
fields.title: Search engines
fields.description: Nofollow asks search engines not to pass your ranking on to the sites you link to.

choices.title: Mark them as paid or affiliate links (sponsored)

fields.name: own-domains
fields.title: Your other domains
fields.description: Domains that also count as your own, separated by commas, for example: shop.example.com, example.nl. Your site's own domain is picked up when you publish.

fields.name: skip-domains
fields.title: Leave these domains alone
fields.description: Links to these domains are never changed, for example: youtube.com.
